title: SPEAK THIS OVER YOUR MORNING BEFORE THE ENEMY PLANTS HIS SEEDS

This is not by accident. You are here by divine arrangement. Don't rush. Don't be casual. Something is about to happen that will change your life forever. He knows that when he engages heaven in the morning, heaven responds. And I want you to understand that God is a rewarder of those who diligently seek him. When you seek God in the morning, diligently, intentionally, strategically, God rewards you. He rewards you with protection. He rewards you with direction. He rewards you with provision. He rewards you with favor. He rewards you with breakthrough. Hallelujah. Now, let me give you the revelation that will transform your life.
